adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the code locates an existing credential via `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId: reqBody.userId, appId: appMetadata.slug } })` and then updates that single record. Because it uses `findFirst` and does not further scope by `type` (or any other discriminator) nor enforce a unique lookup, if multiple credential rows can exist for the same `(userId, appId)` pair, this will update an arbitrary matching record. That is a concrete correctness risk visible in the diff. The second claim about "team credentials with null userId" is not really supported here: the webhook schema requires `userId: z.number().int()` and comments indicate it is user-based, so team credentials aren’t "ignored" so much as out of scope.
